dn24:1.1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā mallesu viharati anupiyā nāma mallānaṃ nigamo.

dn24:1.1.6: yannūnāhaṃ yena bhaggavagottassa paribbājakassa ārāmo, yena bhaggavagotto paribbājako tenupasaṅkameyyanti.”

dn24:1.2.2: atha kho bhaggavagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn24:1.2.5: cirassaṃ kho bhante bhagavā imaṃ pariyāyamakāsi yadidaṃ idhāgamanāya.
dn24:1.2.8: bhaggavagotto’pi kho paribbājako aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
dn24:1.2.9: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho bhaggavagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn24:1.2.10: “purimāni bhante, divasāni purimatarāni sunakkhatto licchaviputto yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā maṃ etadavoca:
dn24:1.2.13: kaccetaṃ bhante tatheva, yathā sunakkhatto licchaviputto avacā?”ti.
dn24:1.2.14: “tatheva kho etaṃ bhaggava, yathā sunakkhatto licchaviputto avaca.
dn24:1.3.1: purimāni bhaggava divasāni purimatarāni sunakkhatto licchaviputto yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho bhaggava sunakkhatto licchaviputto maṃ etadavoca:
dn24:1.3.4: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhaggava sunakkhattaṃ licchaviputtaṃ etadavocaṃ:
dn24:1.3.6: ehi tvaṃ sunakkhatta, mamaṃ uddissa viharāhī ti?”
dn24:1.3.9: ahaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ uddissa viharissāmī ti?”
dn24:1.3.12: ehi tvaṃ sunakkhatta mamaṃ uddissa viharāhīti.
dn24:1.3.14: ahaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ uddissa viharissāmī ti.
dn24:1.3.15: evaṃ sante moghapurisa ko santo kaṃ paccācikkhasi?
dn24:1.3.16: passa moghapurisa yāvañca te idaṃ aparaddhanti.”

dn24:1.4.3: ehi tvaṃ sunakkhatta, mamaṃ uddissa viharāhi, ahante uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karissāmī ti?”
dn24:1.4.6: ahaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ uddissa viharissāmi, bhagavā me uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karissatī ti?”
dn24:1.4.9: ehi tvaṃ sunakkhatta, mamaṃ uddissa viharāhi, ahante uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karissāmī ti.
dn24:1.4.10: na pi kira maṃ tvaṃ vadesi:
dn24:1.4.11: ahaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ uddissa viharissāmi, bhagavā me uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karissatī ti.
dn24:1.4.12: evaṃ sante moghapurisa ko santo kaṃ paccācikkhasi?
dn24:1.4.14: kate vā uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriye akate vā uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriye, yassatthāya mayā dhammo desito so niyyāti takkarassa sammādukkhakkhayāyā?”ti.
dn24:1.4.15: “kate vā bhante, uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriye akate vā uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriye, yassatthāya bhagavatā dhammo desito so niyyāti takkarassa sammādukkhakkhayāyā”ti.
dn24:1.4.16: “iti kira sunakkhatta, kate vā uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriye akate vā uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriye, yassatthāya mayā dhammo desito so niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāyā ti,
dn24:1.4.17: tatra sunakkhatta kiṃ uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ kataṃ karissati?
dn24:1.4.18: passa moghapurisa yāvañca te idaṃ aparaddhanti.”

dn24:1.5.6: ahaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ uddissa viharissāmi, bhagavā me aggaññaṃ paññapessatī ti?”

dn24:1.6.1: anekapariyāyena kho te sunakkhatta mama vaṇṇo bhāsito vajjigāme:
dn24:1.6.2: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā ti.
dn24:1.6.3: iti kho te sunakkhatta anekapariyāyena mama vaṇṇo bhāsito vajjigāme.
dn24:1.6.4: anekapariyāyena kho te sunakkhatta dhammassa vaṇṇo bhāsito vajjigāme;
dn24:1.6.5: svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī”ti.
dn24:1.6.6: iti kho te sunakkhatta anekapariyāyena dhammassa vaṇṇo bhāsito vajjigāme.
dn24:1.6.7: anekapariyāyena kho te sunakkhatta saṅghassa vaṇṇo bhāsito vajjigāme:
dn24:1.6.8: supaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ujupaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ñāyapaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, sāmīcipaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, yadidaṃ cattāri purisayugāni aṭṭha purisapuggalā, esa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, āhuneyyo pāhuṇeyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā ti.
dn24:1.6.9: iti kho te sunakkhatta anekapariyāyena saṅghassa vaṇṇo bhāsito vajjigāme.
dn24:1.6.10: ārocayāmi kho te sunakkhatta paṭivedayāmi kho te sunakkhatta,
dn24:1.6.11: bhavissanti kho te sunakkhatta vattāro: no visahi sunakkhatto licchaviputto samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ. so avisahanto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatto ti.
dn24:1.6.12: iti kho te sunakkhatta bhavissanti vattāro’ti.
dn24:1.6.13: evaṃ kho bhaggava sunakkhatto licchaviputto mayā vuccamāno apakkameva imasmā dhammavinayā yathā taṃ āpāyiko nerayiko.
dn24:1.7.1: ekamidāhaṃ bhaggava, samayaṃ khulūsu viharāmi, uttarakā nāma khulūnaṃ nigamo.
dn24:1.7.2: atha khvāhaṃ bhaggava pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sunakkhattena licchaviputtena pacchāsamaṇena uttarakaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ.
dn24:1.7.3: tena kho pana samayena acelo korakkhattiyo kukkuravatiko cātukuṇḍiko chamā nikiṇṇaṃ bhakkhasaṃ mukheneva khādati mukheneva bhuñjati
dn24:1.7.4: addasā kho bhaggava sunakkhatto licchaviputto acelaṃ korakkhattiyaṃ kukkuravatikaṃ cātukuṇḍikaṃ chamā nikiṇṇaṃ bhakkhasaṃ mukheneva khādantaṃ mukheneva bhuñjantaṃ.
dn24:1.7.6: sādhurūpo vata bho arahaṃ samaṇo cātukuṇḍiko chamā nikiṇṇaṃ bhakkhasaṃ mukheneva khādati mukheneva bhuñjatī ti.
dn24:1.7.7: atha khvāhaṃ bhaggava, sunakkhattassa licchaviputtassa cetasā ceto parivitakkamaññāya sunakkhattaṃ licchaviputtaṃ etadavocaṃ:
dn24:1.7.10: tvampi nāma moghapurisa samaṇo sakyaputtiyo paṭijānissasī ti?’
dn24:1.7.11: “nanu te sunakkhatta, imaṃ acelaṃ korakkhattiyaṃ kukkuravatikaṃ cātukuṇḍikaṃ chamā nikiṇṇaṃ bhakkhasaṃ mukheneva khādantaṃ mukheneva bhuñjantaṃ. disvāna etadahosi:
dn24:1.7.12: sādhurūpo vata bho arahā samaṇo cātukuṇḍiko chamā nikiṇṇaṃ bhakkhasaṃ mukheneva khādati mukheneva bhuñjatī ti?”
dn24:1.7.14: kiṃ pana bhante bhagavā arahattassa maccharāyatī?”ti.
dn24:1.7.16: api ca tuyhevetaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ, taṃ pajaha.
dn24:1.7.17: mā te ahosi dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
dn24:1.7.18: yaṃ kho panetaṃ sunakkhatta maññasi acelaṃ korakkhattiyaṃ: sādhurūpo arahaṃ samaṇo ti, so sattamaṃ divasaṃ alasakena kālaṃ karissati,
dn24:1.7.19: kālakato ca - kālakañjikā nāma asurā, sabbanihīno asurakāyo - tatra upapajjissati.
dn24:1.7.21: ākaṅkhamāno ca tvaṃ sunakkhatta acelaṃ korakkhattiyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā puccheyyāsi:
dn24:1.7.22: jānāsi āvuso acela korakkhattiya attano gatinti?
dn24:1.7.23: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ sunakkhatta vijjati, yante acelo korakkhattiyo byākarissati:
dn24:1.7.25: kālakañjikā nāma asurā, sabbanihīno asurakāyo - tatramhi upapanno”ti.
dn24:1.8.1: atha kho bhaggava, sunakkhatto licchaviputto yena acelo korakkhattiyo tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā acelaṃ korakkhattiyaṃ etadavoca:
dn24:1.8.2: byākato kho’si āvuso korakkhattiya samaṇena gotamena;
dn24:1.8.3: acelo korakkhattiyo sattamaṃ divasaṃ alasakena kālaṃ karissati,
dn24:1.8.4: kālakato ca - kālakañjikā nāma asurā, sabbanihīno asurakāyo - tatra upapajjissati.
dn24:1.8.6: yena tvaṃ āvuso korakkhattiya mattamattañca bhattaṃ bhuñjeyyāsi, mattamattañca pānīyaṃ piveyyāsi,
dn24:1.8.7: yathā samaṇassa gotamassa micchā assa vacananti”.
dn24:1.8.8: atha kho bhaggava sunakkhatto licchaviputto ekadvīhikāya sattarattindivāni gaṇesi yathā taṃ tathāgatassa asaddahamāno.
dn24:1.8.9: atha kho bhaggava, acelo korakkhattiyo sattamaṃ divasaṃ alasakena kālamakāsi.
dn24:1.8.10: kālakato ca - kālakañjikā nāma asurā, sabbanihīno asurakāyo - tatra upapajji.
dn24:1.9.2: acelo kira korakkhattiyo alasakena kālakato bīraṇatthambhake susāne chaḍḍito’ti.
dn24:1.9.3: atha kho bhaggava, sunakkhatto licchaviputto yena bīraṇatthambhakaṃ susānaṃ yena acelo korakkhattiyo tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā acelaṃ korakkhattiyaṃ tikkhattuṃ pāṇinā ākoṭesi:
dn24:1.9.5: atha kho bhaggava acelo korakkhattiyo pāṇinā piṭṭhiṃ paripuñjanto vuṭṭhāsi
dn24:1.9.7: kālakañjikā nāma asurā - sabbanihīno asurakāyo, tatramhi upapanno ti vatvā tattheva uttāno paripati.
dn24:1.10.1: atha kho bhaggava, sunakkhatto licchaviputto yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho ahaṃ bhaggava sunakkhattaṃ licchaviputtaṃ etadavocaṃ:
dn24:1.10.3: yatheva te ahaṃ acelaṃ korakkhattiyaṃ ārabbha byākāsiṃ, tatheva taṃ vipakkaṃ aññathā vā?ti.
dn24:1.10.4: “yatheva me bhante, bhagavā acelaṃ korakkhattiyaṃ ārabbha byākāsi, tatheva taṃ vipakkaṃ no aññathā”ti.
dn24:1.10.6: yadi evaṃ sante kataṃ vā hoti uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ akataṃ vā?”ti.
dn24:1.10.7: “addhā kho bhante, evaṃ sante kataṃ hoti uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ no akatanti.”
dn24:1.10.8: evampi kho maṃ tvaṃ moghapurisa, uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karontaṃ evaṃ vadesi:
dn24:1.10.9: na hi pana me bhante bhagavā uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karotī’ti.
dn24:1.10.10: passa moghapurisa, yāvañca te idaṃ aparaddhanti.
dn24:1.10.11: evampi kho bhaggava, sunakkhatto licchaviputto mayā vuccamāno apakkameva imasmā dhammavinayā, yathā taṃ āpāyiko nerayiko. kaḷāramaṭṭhukavatthu
dn24:1.11.1: ekamidāhaṃ bhaggava, samayaṃ vesāliyaṃ viharāmi mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
dn24:1.11.2: tena kho pana samayena acelo kaḷāramaṭṭhuko vesāliyaṃ paṭivasati lābhaggappatto ceva yasaggappatto ca vajjigāme.
dn24:1.11.3: tassa satta vatapadāni samattāni samādinnāni honti:
dn24:1.11.4: yāvajīvaṃ acelako assaṃ na vatthaṃ paridaheyyaṃ. yāvajīvaṃ brahmacārī assaṃ na methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseveyyaṃ. yāvajīvaṃ surāmaṃseneva yāpeyyaṃ na odanakummāsaṃ bhuñjeyyaṃ.
dn24:1.11.5: puratthimena vesāliṃ udenaṃ nāma cetiyaṃ taṃ nātikkameyyaṃ, dakkhiṇena vesāliṃ gotamakaṃ nāma cetiyaṃ taṃ nātikkameyyaṃ, pacchimena vesāliṃ sattambaṃ nāma cetiyaṃ taṃ nātikkameyyaṃ, uttarena vesāliṃ bahuputtaṃ nāma cetiyaṃ taṃ nātikkameyya’nti.”
dn24:1.11.6: so imesaṃ sattannaṃ vatapadānaṃ samādānahetu lābhaggappatto ceva yasaggappatto ca vajjigāme.
dn24:1.12.1: atha kho bhaggava, sunakkhatto licchaviputto yena acelo kaḷāramaṭṭhuko tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā acelaṃ kaḷāramaṭṭhukaṃ pañhaṃ pucchi.
dn24:1.12.2: tassa acelo kaḷāramaṭṭhuko pañhaṃ puṭṭho na sampāyāsi.

dn24:2.3.13: ‘ahaṃ taṃ vācaṃ appahāya …pe… samaṇassa gotamassa sammukhībhāvaṃ gaccheyyanti muddhā pi tassa vipateyyā”ti.
dn24:2.4.1: atha kho bhaggava, jāliyo dārupattikantevāsī uṭṭhāyāsanā taṃ parisaṃ etadavoca:
dn24:2.4.2: tena hi bho muhuttaṃ tāva āgametha yāvāhaṃ gacchāmi,
dn24:2.4.3: appevanāma ahampi sakkuṇeyyaṃ acelaṃ pāthikaputtaṃ imaṃ parisaṃ ānetunti.
dn24:2.4.4: atha kho bhaggava, jāliyo dārupattikantevāsī yena tindukakhāṇuparibbājakārāmo yena acelo pāthikaputto tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā acelaṃ pāthikaputtaṃ etadavoca:
dn24:2.4.5: abhikkamāvuso pāthikaputta, abhikkantaṃ te seyyo. abhikkantā abhiññātā abhiññātā licchavī …pe… samaṇopi gotamo āyasmato ārāme divāvihāraṃ nisinno.
dn24:2.4.6: bhāsitā kho pana te āvuso pāthikaputta vesāliyaṃ parisatiṃ vācā:
dn24:2.4.10: sabbapaṭhamaññeva āgantvā samaṇo gotamo āyasmato ārāme divāvihāraṃ nisinno.
dn24:2.4.11: bhāsitā kho pane te esāvuso pāthikaputta samaṇena gotamena parisatiṃ vācā:
dn24:2.4.12: “abhabbo acelo pāthikaputto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya …pe… sace pi’ssa
dn24:2.4.14: “ahaṃ taṃ vācaṃ appahāya …pe… samaṇassa gotamassa sammukhībhāvaṃ gaccheyya”nti, muddhāpi tassa vipateyya.
dn24:2.4.16: mayaṃ acelaṃ pāthikaputtaṃ varattāhi bandhitvā goyugehi āviñjeyyāmāti. tā varattā chijjeraṃ pāthikaputto vā.
dn24:2.4.17: abhabbo pana acelo pāthikaputto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā mama sammukhībhāvaṃ āgantuṃ.
dn24:2.4.19: “ahaṃ taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā samaṇassa gotamassa sammukhībhāvaṃ āgaccheyyanti muddhā pi tassa vipateyyā”ti.
dn24:2.4.20: abhikkamāvuso pāthikaputta, abhikkamaneneva te jayaṃ karissāma, samaṇassa gotamassa parājayanti.
dn24:2.5.1: evaṃ vutte bhaggava, acelo pāthikaputto ‘āyāmi āvuso, āyāmi āvuso’ti vatvā tattheva saṃsappati, na sakkoti āsanā’pi vuṭṭhātuṃ,
dn24:2.5.2: atha kho bhaggava, jāliyo dārupattikantevāsī acelaṃ pāthikaputtaṃ etadavoca:
dn24:2.5.3: “kiṃ su nāma te āvuso pāthikaputta pāvaḷā su nāma te pīṭhakasmiṃ allīnā, pīṭhakaṃ su nāma te pāvaḷāsu allīnaṃ
dn24:2.5.4: āyāmi āvuso, āyāmi āvuso’ti vatvā tattheva saṃsappasi, na sakkosi āsanā pi vuṭṭhātunti?”
dn24:2.5.5: evampi kho bhaggava, vuccamāno acelo pāthikaputto ‘āyāmi āvuso, āyāmi āvuso’ti vatvā tattheva saṃsappati, na sakkoti āsanā pi vuṭṭhātunti.
dn24:2.6.1: yadā kho bhaggava, jāliyo dārupattikantevāsī aññāsi
dn24:2.6.2: parābhūtarūpo ayaṃ acelo pāthikaputto, ‘āyāmi āvuso, āyāmi āvuso’ti vatvā tattheva saṃsappati, na sakkoti āsanā pi vuṭṭhātunti, atha naṃ etadavoca:
dn24:2.6.4: yannūnāhaṃ aññataraṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ nissāya āsayaṃ kappeyyaṃ,
dn24:2.6.5: tatrāsayaṃ kappetvā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ āsayā nikkhameyyaṃ, āsayā nikkhamitvā vijambheyyaṃ, vijambhitvā samantā catuddisā anuvilokeyyaṃ, samantā catuddisā anuviloketvā tikkhattuṃ sīhanādaṃ nadeyyaṃ, tikkhattuṃ sīhanādaṃ naditvā gocarāya pakkameyyaṃ,
dn24:2.6.6: so varaṃ varaṃ vigasaṅghe vadhitvā mudumaṃsāni mudumaṃsāni bhakkhayitvā tameva āsayaṃ ajjhupeyyanti.
dn24:2.6.7: atha kho so sīho migarājā aññataraṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ nissāya āsayaṃ kappesi.
dn24:2.6.8: tatrāsayaṃ kappetvā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ āsayā nikkhami. āsayā nikkhamitvā vijambhi. vijambhitvā samantā catuddisā anuvilokesi. samantā catuddisā anuviloketvā tikkhattuṃ sīhanādaṃ nadi. tikkhattuṃ sīhanādaṃ naditvā gocarāya pakkami.
dn24:2.6.9: so varaṃ varaṃ migasaṅghe vadhitvā mudumaṃsāni mudumaṃsāni bhakkhayitvā tameva āsayaṃ ajjhupesi.
dn24:2.6.10: tasseva kho āvuso pāthikaputta, sīhassa migarañño vighāsesaṃvaddho jarasigālo ditto ceva balavā ca.
dn24:2.6.11: atha kho āvuso tassa jarasigālassa etadahosi
dn24:2.6.13: yannūnāhampi aññataraṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ nissāya āsayaṃ kappeyyaṃ,
dn24:2.6.14: tatrāsayaṃ kappetvā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ āsayā nikkhameyyaṃ, āsayā nikkhamitvā vijambheyyaṃ, vijambhitvā samantā catuddisā anuvilokeyyaṃ, samantā catuddisā anuviloketvā tikkhattuṃ sīhanādaṃ nadeyyaṃ, tikkhattuṃ sīhanādaṃ naditvā gocarāya pakkameyyaṃ.
dn24:2.6.15: so varaṃ varaṃ migasaṃghe vadhitvā mudumaṃsāni mudumaṃsāni bhakkhayitvā tamevāsayaṃ ajjhupeyyanti.”
dn24:2.7.1: atha kho so āvuso jarasigālo aññataraṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ nissāya āsayaṃ kappesi.
dn24:2.7.2: tatrāsayaṃ kappetvā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ āsayā nikkhami. āsayā nikkhamitvā vijambhi. vijambhitvā samantā catuddisā anuvilokesi. samantā catuddisā anuviloketvā tikkhattuṃ sīhanādaṃ nadissāmī ti segālakaṃ yeva anadi, bheraṇḍakaṃ yeva anadi. ko ca chaco segālako ko pana sīhanādo!
dn24:2.7.3: “evameva kho tvaṃ āvuso pāthikaputta, sugatāpadānesu jīvamāno sugatātirittāni bhuñjamāno tathāgate arahante sammāsambuddhe āsādetabbaṃ maññasi.
dn24:2.7.4: ko ca chavo pāthikaputto kā ca tathāgatānaṃ arahantānaṃ sammāsambuddhānaṃ āsādanā!”ti.
dn24:2.8.1: yato kho bhaggava, jāliyo dārupattikantevāsī iminā opammena neva asakkhi acelaṃ pāthikaputtaṃ tamhā āsanā cāvetuṃ,
dn24:2.8.6: ko ca chavo segālo ko pana sīhanādo!ti.
dn24:2.8.7: evameva kho tvaṃ āvuso pāthikaputta, sugatāpadānesu jīvamāno sugatātirittāni bhuñjamāno tathāgate arahante sammāsambuddhe āsādetabbaṃ maññasi.
dn24:2.8.8: ko ca chavo pāṭikaputto kā ca tathāgatānaṃ arahantānaṃ sammāsambuddhānaṃ āsādanā!ti.

dn24:2.9.8: ko ca chavo segālo ko pana sīhanādo!ti.

dn24:2.10.8: ko ca chavo segālo ko pana sīhanādo!ti.

dn24:2.10.10: ko ca chavo pāthikaputto, kā ca tathāgatānaṃ arahantānaṃ sammāsambuddhānaṃ āsādanā!ti.
dn24:2.11.1: yato kho bhaggava, jāliyo dārupattikantevāsī iminā pi opammena neva asakkhi acelaṃ pāthikaputtaṃ tamhā āsanā cāvetuṃ.
dn24:2.11.3: “parābhūtarūpo bho acelo pāthikaputto, ‘āyāmi āvuso, āyāmi āvuso’ti vatvā tattheva saṃsappati, na sakkoti āsanāpi vuṭṭhātunti.
dn24:2.12.1: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhaggava taṃ parisaṃ etadavocaṃ:
dn24:2.12.2: “abhabbo kho āvuso acelo pāthikaputto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā mama sammukhībhāvaṃ āgantuṃ.
dn24:2.12.4: ahaṃ taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā samaṇassa gotamassa sammukhībhāvaṃ gaccheyyanti, muddhā pi tassa vipateyya.
dn24:2.12.6: “mayaṃ acelaṃ pāthikaputtaṃ varattāhi bandhitvā goyugehi āviñcheyyāmāti, tā varattā chijjeraṃ pāthikaputto vā.
dn24:2.12.7: abhabbo pana acelo pāthikaputto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā mama sammukhībhāvaṃ āgantuṃ.
dn24:2.12.8: sace’pi’ssa evamassa ‘ahaṃ taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā samaṇassa gotamassa sammukhībhāvaṃ gaccheyyanti muddhā pi tassa vipateyyā”ti.
dn24:2.13.1: atha khvāhaṃ bhaggava, taṃ parisaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesiṃ samādapesiṃ samuttejesiṃ sampahaṃsesiṃ. taṃ parisaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā mahābandhanā mokkhaṃ karitvā, caturāsītipāṇasahassāni mahāviduggā uddharitvā, tejodhātuṃ samāpajjitvā sattatālaṃ vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā aññaṃ sattatālampi acciṃ abhinimminitvā pajjalitvā dhūmāyitvā mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ paccuṭṭhāsiṃ.
dn24:2.13.2: atha kho bhaggava sunakkhatto licchaviputto yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho ahaṃ bhaggava sunakkhattaṃ licchaviputtaṃ etadavocaṃ:
dn24:2.13.4: yatheva te ahaṃ acelaṃ pāthikaputtaṃ ārabbha byākāsiṃ, tatheva taṃ vipakkaṃ aññathā vā?ti.
dn24:2.13.5: “yatheva me bhante bhagavā acelaṃ pāthikaputtaṃ ārabbha byākāsi, tatheva taṃ vipakkaṃ no aññathā”ti.
dn24:2.13.7: yadi evaṃ sante kataṃ vā hoti uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ akataṃ vā?”ti.
dn24:2.13.8: “addhā kho pana bhante, evaṃ sante kataṃ hoti uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ no akatanti.”
dn24:2.13.9: “evampi kho maṃ tvaṃ moghapurisa, uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karontaṃ evaṃ vadesi:
dn24:2.13.10: na hi pana me bhante bhagavā uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karotī ti.
dn24:2.13.11: passa moghapurisa tañca te idaṃ aparaddhanti.”
dn24:2.13.12: evampi kho bhaggava, sunakkhatto licchaviputto mayā vuccamāno apakkameva imasmā dhammavinayā yathā taṃ āpādhiko nerayiko.
dn24:2.14.2: tañca pajānāmi tateṃ ca uttaritaraṃ pajānāmi, tañca pajānanaṃna parāmasāmi, aparāmasato ca me paccattaññeva nibbuti viditā, yadabhijānaṃ tathāgato no anayaṃ āpajjati.
dn24:2.14.3: santi bhaggava, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā issarakuttaṃ brahmakuttaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññāpenti.
dn24:2.14.5: saccaṃ kira tumhe āyasmanto issarakuttaṃ brahmakuttaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethā?”ti.
dn24:2.14.6: te ca me evaṃ puṭṭhā ‘āmo’ti paṭijānanti.
dn24:2.14.8: kathaṃvihitakaṃ pana tumhe āyasmanto issarakuttaṃ brahmakuttaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethā”ti.
dn24:2.14.9: te mayā puṭṭhā na sampāyanti. asampāyantā mamaññeva paṭipucchanti.
dn24:2.14.11: hoti kho so āvuso samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena ayaṃ loko saṃvaṭṭati.
dn24:2.14.12: saṃvaṭṭamāne loke yebhuyyena sattā ābhassarasaṃvattanikā honti.
dn24:2.14.13: te tattha honti manomayā pītibhakkhā sayampabhā antalikkhacarā subhaṭṭhāyino, ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ tiṭṭhanti.
dn24:2.15.1: hoti kho so āvuso samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena ayaṃ loko vivaṭṭati,
dn24:2.15.3: atha kho aññataro satto āyukkhayā vā puññakkhayā vā ābhassarakāyā cavitvā suññaṃ brahmavimānaṃ upapajjati.
dn24:2.15.4: so tattha hoti manomayo pītibhakkho sayampabho antalikkhacaro subhaṭṭhāyī, ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ tiṭṭhati.
dn24:2.16.1: tassa tattha ekakassa dīgharattaṃ nivusitattā anabhirati paritassanā uppajjati:
dn24:2.16.2: “aho vata aññe pi sattā itthattaṃ āgaccheyyunti”.
dn24:2.16.3: atha aññatare pi sattā āyukkhayā vā puññakkhayā vā ābhassarakāyā cavitvā suññaṃ brahmavimānaṃ upapajjanti tassa sattassa sahabyataṃ.
dn24:2.16.4: te pi tattha honti manomayā pītibhakkhā sayampabhā antalikkhacarā subhaṭṭhāyino ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ tiṭṭhanti.
dn24:2.17.1: tatrāvuso yo so satto paṭhamaṃ upapanno, tassa evaṃ hoti:
dn24:2.17.2: ahamasmi brahmā mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthudaso vasavattī issaro kattā nimmātā saṭṭhā sajitā vasī pitā bhūtabhavyānaṃ. mayā ime sattā nimmitā.
dn24:2.17.5: “aho vata aññe pi sattā itthattaṃ āgaccheyyunti.
dn24:2.17.6: iti mamañca manopaṇidhi. ime ca sattā itthattaṃ āgatā”ti.
dn24:2.17.7: ye pi te sattā pacchā upapannā, tesampi evaṃ hoti;
dn24:2.17.8: ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ brahmā mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthudaso vasavattī issaro kattā nimmātā saṭṭhā sajitā vasī pitā bhūtabhavyānaṃ.
dn24:2.17.11: imañhi mayaṃ addasāma idha paṭhamaṃ upapannaṃ, mayaṃ panamhā pacchā upapannā’ti.
dn24:2.17.12: tatrāvuso yo so satto paṭhamaṃ upapanno, so dīghāyukataro ca hoti vaṇṇavantataro ca mahesakkhataro ca.
dn24:2.17.13: ye pana te sattā pacchā uppannā, te appāyukatarā ca honti dubbaṇṇatarā ca appesakkhatarā ca.
dn24:2.17.14: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ āvuso vijjati yaṃ aññataro satto tamhā kāyā cavitvā itthattaṃ āgacchati.
dn24:2.17.15: itthattaṃ āgato samāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
dn24:2.17.16: agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito samāno ātappamanvāya padhānamanvāya anuyogamanvāya appamādamanvāya sammāmanasikāramanvāya tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati, yathā samāhite citte taṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati, tato paraṃ nānussaratī ti.
dn24:2.17.18: yo kho so bhavaṃ brahmā mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthudaso vasavattī issaro kattā nimmātā saṭṭhā sajitā vasī pitā bhūtabhavyānaṃ, yena mayaṃ bhotā brahmunā nimmitā, so nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassati.
dn24:2.17.19: ye pana mayaṃ ahumhā tena bhotā brahmunā nimmitā, te mayaṃ aniccā addhuvā appāyukā cavanadhammā itthattaṃ āgatā ti.
dn24:2.17.20: evaṃvihitakaṃ no tumhe āyasmanto issarakuttaṃ brahmakuttaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññāpethā”ti.
dn24:2.17.22: “evaṃ kho no āvuso gotama sutaṃ yathevāyasmā gotamo āhā”ti.
dn24:2.18.1: santi bhaggava, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā khiḍḍāpadosikaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññāpenti.
dn24:2.18.3: saccaṃ kira tumhe āyasmanto khiḍḍāpadosikaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññāpethā?ti”.
dn24:2.18.4: te ca me evaṃ puṭṭhā ‘āmo’ti paṭijānanti.
dn24:2.18.6: kathaṃvihitakaṃ pana tumhe āyasmanto khiḍḍāpadosikaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññāpethā?ti.
dn24:2.18.7: te mayā puṭṭhā na sampāyanti. asampāyantā mamaññeva paṭipucchanti.
dn24:2.18.9: santāvuso khiḍḍāpadosikā nāma devā. te ativelaṃ hassakhiḍḍāratidhammasamāpannā viharanti tesaṃ ativelaṃ hassakhiḍḍāratidhammasamāpannānaṃ viharataṃ sati sammussati. satiyā sammosā te devā tamhā kāyā cavanti.
dn24:2.18.10: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ āvuso vijjati, yaṃ aññataro satto tamhā kāyā cavitvā itthattaṃ āgacchati.
dn24:2.18.11: itthattaṃ āgato samāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
dn24:2.18.12: agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito samāno ātappamanvāya padhānamanvāya anuyogamanvāya appamādamanvāya sammāmanasikāramanvāya tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati yathā samāhite citte taṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati tatoparaṃ nānussaratī ti.
dn24:2.18.14: ye kho te bhonto devā na, khiḍḍāpadosikā te na ativelaṃ hassakhiḍḍāratidhammasamāpannā viharanti. tesaṃ na ativelaṃ hassakhiḍḍāratidhammasamāpannānaṃ viharataṃ sati na sammussati. satiyā asammosā te devā tamhā kāyā na cavanti,
dn24:2.18.15: niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammā sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassanti.
dn24:2.18.16: ye pana mayaṃ ahumhā khiḍḍāpadosikā te mayaṃ ativelaṃ hassakhiḍḍāratidhammasamāpannā viharimhā. tesaṃ no ativelaṃ hassakhiḍḍāratidhammasamāpannānaṃ viharataṃ sati sammussi. satiyā sammosā evaṃ mayaṃ tamhā kāyā cutā
dn24:2.18.17: aniccā addhuvā appāyukā cavanadhammā itthattaṃ āgatā”ti.
dn24:2.18.18: evaṃvihitakaṃ no tumhe āyasmanto khiḍḍāpadosikaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethā?ti.
dn24:2.18.20: evaṃ kho no āvuso gotama sutaṃ yathevāyasmā gotamo āhā ti.
dn24:2.19.1: santi bhaggava, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā manopadosikaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapenti.
dn24:2.19.3: saccaṃ kira tumhe āyasmanto manopadosikaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethā?ti.
dn24:2.19.4: te ca me evaṃ puṭṭhā ‘āmo’ti paṭijānanti.
dn24:2.19.6: kathaṃvihitakaṃ no pana tumhe āyasmanto manopadosikaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃpaññapethā?ti.
dn24:2.19.7: te mayā puṭṭhā na sampāyanti. asampāyantā mamaññeva paṭipucchanti.
dn24:2.19.9: santāvuso manopadosikā nāma devā. te ativelaṃ aññamaññaṃ upanijjhāyanti. te ativelaṃ aññamaññaṃ upanijjhāyantā aññamaññamhi cittāni padūsenti. aññamaññaṃ paduṭṭhacittā kilantakāyā kilantacittā te devā tamhā kāyā cavanti.
dn24:2.19.10: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ āvuso vijjati yaṃ aññataro satto tamhā kāyā cavitvā itthattaṃ āgacchati,
dn24:2.19.11: itthattaṃ āgato samāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
dn24:2.19.12: agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito samāno ātappamanvāya …pe… tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati, yathā samāhite citte taṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati, tato paraṃ nānussaratīti.
dn24:2.19.14: “ye kho te bhonto devā na manopadosikā te nātivelaṃ aññamaññaṃ upanijjhāyanti. te nātivelaṃ aññamaññaṃ upanijjhāyantā aññamaññamhi cittāni nappadūsenti. aññamaññamhi appaduṭṭhacittā akilantakāyā akilantacittā te devā tamhā kāyā na cavanti
dn24:2.19.15: niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammā sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassanti.
dn24:2.19.16: ye pana mayaṃ ahumhā manopadosikā te mayaṃ ativelaṃ aññamaññaṃ upanijjhāyimhā. te mayaṃ ativelaṃ aññamaññaṃ upanijjhāyantā aññamaññamhi cittāni padūsayimhā, te mayaṃ aññamaññamhi paduṭṭhacittā kilantakāyā kilantacittā evaṃ mayaṃ tamhā kāyā cutā
dn24:2.19.17: aniccā addhuvā asassatā appāyukā cavanadhammā itthattaṃ āgatā”ti.
dn24:2.19.18: evaṃvihitakaṃ no tumhe āyasmanto manopadosikaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethā?”ti.
dn24:2.19.20: “evaṃ kho no āvuso gotama sutaṃ yathevāyasmā gotamo āhā”ti.
dn24:2.20.1: santi bhaggava, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā adhiccasamuppannaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapenti.
dn24:2.20.3: saccaṃ kira tumhe āyasmanto adhiccasamuppannaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethā?ti.
dn24:2.20.4: te ca me evaṃ puṭṭhā ‘āmo’ti paṭijānanti.
dn24:2.20.6: kathaṃvihitakaṃ no pana tumhe āyasmanto adhiccasamuppannaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethā?ti.
dn24:2.20.7: te ca mayā puṭṭhā na sampāyanti. asampāyantā mamaññeva paṭipucchanti.
dn24:2.20.10: saññuppādā ca pana te devā tamhā kāya cavanti.
dn24:2.20.11: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ āvuso vijjati, yaṃ aññataro satto tamhā kāyā cavitvā itthattaṃ āgacchati,
dn24:2.20.12: itthattaṃ āgato samāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
dn24:2.20.13: agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito samāno ātappamanvāya padhānamanvāya …pe… tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati yathā samāhite citte taṃ saññūppādaṃ anussarati, tato paraṃ nānussaratī ti.
dn24:2.20.17: ahaṃ pubbe nāhosiṃ, so’mhi etarahi ahutvā santatāya pariṇato”ti.
dn24:2.20.18: evaṃvihitakaṃ no pana tumhe āyasmanto adhiccasamuppannaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethā”ti.
dn24:2.20.20: “evaṃ kho no āvuso gotama sutaṃ yathevāyasmā gotamo āhā”ti.
dn24:2.20.21: aggaññañcāhaṃ bhaggava pajānāmi, tañca pajānāmi, tato ca uttaritaraṃ pajānāmi, tañca pajānanaṃ na parāmasāmi, aparāmasato ca me paccattaññeva nibbuti viditā,
dn24:2.21.1: evaṃvādiṃ kho maṃ bhaggava, evamakkhāyiṃ eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhanti:
dn24:2.21.4: yasmiṃ samaye subhaṃ vimokkhaṃ upasampajja viharati sabbaṃ tasmiṃ samaye asubhantveva pajānātī ti.
dn24:2.21.5: na kho panāhaṃ bhaggava evaṃ vadāmi:
dn24:2.21.6: yasmiṃ samaye subhaṃ vimokkhaṃ upasampajja viharati. sabbaṃ tasmiṃ samaye asubhanteva pajānātīti.
dn24:2.21.8: yasmiṃ samaye subhaṃ vimokkhaṃ upasampajja viharati, subhantveva tasmiṃ samaye pajānātī’ti.
dn24:2.21.9: “te’ca bhante, viparītā ye bhagavantaṃ viparītato dahanti bhikkhavo ca.
dn24:2.21.10: evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ bhante bhagavati, pahoti ca me bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yathā ahaṃ subhaṃ vimokkhaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti.”
dn24:2.21.11: “dukkaraṃ kho evaṃ bhaggava, tayā aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucikena aññatrāyogena aññatrācariyakena subhaṃ vimokkhaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ.
dn24:2.21.12: iṅgha tvaṃ bhaggava, yo ca te ayaṃ mayi pasādo, tameva tvaṃ sādhukamanurakkhā”ti.
dn24:2.21.13: “sace taṃ bhante, mayā dukkaraṃ aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucikena aññatrāyogena aññatra ācariyakena subhaṃ vimokkhaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ,
dn24:2.21.14: yo ca me ayaṃ bhante bhagavati pasādo, tamevāhaṃ sādhukamanurakkhissāmī”ti.
dn24:2.21.16: attamano bhaggavagotto paribbājako bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandī ti.
